title: Course Schedule II
statement: Each entry [a, b] means b must be taken before a. Return any ordering of all the courses that respects every prerequisite, or an empty array when no such ordering exists.
hints: Same graph as Course Schedule, but now you must produce the order rather than just a yes or no.
Kahn topological sort gives it directly: repeatedly take a course with no remaining prerequisites and append it to the output.
If the output is shorter than numCourses when the queue empties, a cycle blocked you, so return an empty array.
